def: a brag or lie; also a liar

words.word: but it shall not be so his lies

occurrences.text: Should thy lies make men hold their peace? and when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed?
I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.
That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise men backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;
I know his wrath, saith the Lord; but it shall not be so; his lies shall not so effect it.
words: but it shall not be so his lies

occurrences.text: A sword is upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword is upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.
